name: @pipeworx/mcp-lemmy

tools.name: posts
tools.description: List Lemmy posts (federated Reddit-alternative; ActivityPub) from a community or feed. Sort by Active / Hot / New / TopDay / TopWeek / etc. Returns post title, body, author, upvotes, comment count. Use for federated open-source discussion forum content.

sort.description: Active | Hot | New | Old | TopDay | TopWeek | TopMonth | TopYear | TopAll | MostComments | NewComments

tools.name: post
tools.description: Fetch a single Lemmy post by numeric id from the specified instance (default lemmy.world). Returns title, body, author, score, comment count, and community.

tools.name: comments
tools.description: List Lemmy comments under a post or thread. Returns author, body, score, parent, posted date. Use to read discussion threads on federated Reddit-alternative communities.

tools.name: communities
tools.description: List communities on a Lemmy instance (default lemmy.world), sortable by Active/Hot/New/TopMonth/etc. and filterable by type (All/Local/Subscribed). Returns community name, description, and subscriber count.

tools.name: community
tools.description: Fetch metadata for a specific Lemmy community by name (e.g. "asklemmy") or numeric id from the specified instance. Returns description, icon, subscriber count, and moderators.

tools.name: site
tools.description: Fetch instance-level metadata for a Lemmy instance (default lemmy.world), including site name, description, version, admin info, and federated instances list.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across a Lemmy instance (default lemmy.world) for posts, comments, communities, or users matching query `q`. Filter by type (Posts/Comments/Communities/Users), listing (All/Local), and sort order.

type_.description: All | Comments | Posts | Communities | Users | Url

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-lemmy forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the lemmy pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
